step_1_identify_the_only_repeat-cast_clo.reasoning: In the shared-timeline model (S6) the damage_events ledger opens with the t=0 cast block (W throw at 0.00, E at 0.25, R spheres at 0.25 - R's effect 'takes place at the start of the cast time' per its wiki notes - and Q/Q2 at 0.60 from the sphere's 0.6 s arm delay, S2). Those fill indices 0..6 for r_spheres in {3,4} with the Q2 charge slot live at 60 Splinters (S7). Index 7 is therefore the FIRST recast on the timeline. R is single-cast (S5), E's effective cooldown is the longest of the three, so the first recast is either W or Q.

candidate_clocks_at_the_scenario's_60.Q: 7.0 s recharge, affectedByCdr FALSE - only R's Q-scoped 10/20/30 haste applies (S2, S3)

step_2_apply_the_quoted_formula.W_rank5_at_AH_60: 8 * 100 / 160 = 5.000000 s   <-- equals the NEW value exactly
step_2_apply_the_quoted_formula.conclusion: The earliest recast epoch is W at exactly 5.00 s; Q's charge follows at 5.38 s and E at 9.38 s. Index 7 = W's second Force of Will = 5.00 s. W has castTime 'none' (S1), so the event time IS the cast epoch - no offset.

step_3_invert_the_old_value.question: What haste would make any sourced Syndra cooldown equal 7.2727 (the 7.27 the ledger printed, i.e. 80/11)?
step_3_invert_the_old_value.why_that_is_wrong: 7.2727 = 8 * 100/110 is Force of Will at rank 5 with exactly 10 ability haste. 10 is not a loadout haste value here (S9) - it is precisely the number Syndra's R passive grants, and the cached wiki text scopes that haste to Dark Sphere alone: 'Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste' (S3). A W recast at 7.27 s therefore requires either leaking Q-scoped haste onto W while discarding the loadout's real haste, or reading W's cooldown at the wrong rank. Neither is supported by any source in data/. Every other rank/ability inversion (23.75, 37.50, 51.25, 65, 106.25 AH) is an off-grid haste total that no combination in data/items.json produces alongside the 5.00 s result the same fight also has to admit.
step_3_invert_the_old_value.internal_inconsistency: Note the two values cannot both come from the same haste state: 7.27 forces AH=10 on W, while the scenario's own axis value 60 forces AH=60 -> 5.00. Only one of these is consistent with the shared clock the rest of the ledger runs on.

residual_uncertainty: The golden corpus scenario tuple (level, ranks, item list, cast_order, target stats) lives outside the permitted evidence tree (tests//scripts/), so the input haste of 60 is taken from the scenario identifier 'syndra_custom_order_60' plus the audit note (S7) that 60 is a Syndra option value; the arithmetic 8*100/160 = 5.000 is exact and self-consistent with that reading.

Under the alternative reading where the trailing 60 is a fight length in seconds rather than the option/haste value, the conclusion is unchanged in direction: 5.00 s is still exactly W rank 5 at a round, buildable 60 ability haste, whereas 7.27 s still requires exactly 10 ability haste on W - the one number the wiki text reserves for Dark Sphere only.

If index 7 were instead a Q charge event, the sourced value would be 5.38 s (7*100/130) or 5.98 s with the 0.6 s sphere delay - neither is 7.27, so the old value is unsupported under every candidate identification of the event.
verdict_rationale: 5.0 is reproduced exactly by the quoted effective-cooldown identity cd*100/(100+AH) applied to Force of Will's cached rank-5 cooldown of 8 s, on the shared-timeline recast epoch rule from math-foundations 1.1, with a zero cast time so the event lands on the epoch. 7.27 is reproducible only by giving Force of Will 10 ability haste - the exact figure the cached wiki text restricts to Dark Sphere's cooldown - and is not derivable from any Syndra cooldown in data/champions.json under any loadout haste the item cache can produce.
